description: Returns normalized, source-linked business records for Orange County, CA barbershops. Use when: the user wants to find or compare local Orange County barbershops with constraints such as city, published service, or availability class. Do not use when: the user needs beauty categories beyond the published barbershop subcategory, results outside Orange County, guaranteed real-time appointment slots or prices, payment, or a completed booking.

availability_class.description: Optional availability class: live, booking-site, or none.

city.description: Optional Orange County city name, such as Irvine, Orange, or Santa Ana.

service.description: Optional published barbershop service, such as haircut, beard trim, or fade.

name: search
title: Search Orange County Barbershops
